consequence.statement: This change only adds an allowed enum value and removes none, so existing PrometheusAgent resources are still accepted. Operators can now choose the new value.

original.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 PrometheusAgent CRD schema, spec.otlp.translationStrategy now also accepts "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes". No previously allowed values were removed, so existing resources are still accepted.

decision.reason: The computed artifact diff between the v0.85.0 and v0.86.2 PrometheusAgent CRDs [ev-7d96c48a5c71] [ev-4393a79e776d] says spec.otlp.translationStrategy has removed [] and added ["UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes"]. Since no value was removed, no existing resource is rejected and nothing stops working, so "none" (informational) holds. The crd-schema:tightened validator's finding that the enum is unchanged also points to no consequence. Confidence is low because the evidence excerpts themselves are empty and only the computed diff text states the enum delta.
